parent_objective: design source-rich public generalization gate for the promoted M1362 public base
blocked_by: M1371 opens the promoted-base source-rich/comparison readiness branch
supersedes: running source-rich evaluation without a promoted-base gate design
using private holdout for source-rich debugging
claiming true per-wheel asymmetric faults from current single-track proxy configs

public_gates: M1372 must design source-rich public generalization for the promoted M1362 base
M1372 must separate current-model faults from proxy/future-only high-fidelity faults
M1372 must keep private holdout unused
M1372 must not train, run PPO, run evaluation, or change actor inputs
M1372 must keep L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison and source-rich gate ordering explicit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run source-rich evaluation in the design milestone
do not claim true single-wheel, split-mu, halfshaft, or suspension physics from proxy configs
do not claim paper-level evidence or level3 self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first source-rich public generalization gate after M1362 becomes public base
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no source-rich run, private holdout, PPO, paper-level, high-fidelity, L0/L1/L2/L3 result, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if current-model fault and proxy fault claims are mixed
stop if private holdout is proposed for debugging
stop if source-rich gate would be used to claim true asymmetric wheel physics
stop if L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison budget is changed after results
fallback_plan: if existing source-rich evaluator is usable, route to a no-training promoted-base source-rich public gate
if tooling is missing, route to evaluator implementation
if proxy claim boundaries are ambiguous, route to source-rich claim-boundary audit
if comparison protocol is stale, route to fair-comparison refresh design after source-rich gate design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1371 opens the promoted-base source-rich/comparison readiness branch

admission_evidence: M1370 promotes M1362 alpha 0.1 as the public-gate base
M1371 selects source-rich public generalization as the next evidence branch
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: source-rich public gate scope is defined
required artifacts and metrics are defined
next implementation or run milestone is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1372 only designs source-rich evaluation and cannot claim history necessity or level3 self-ID.
history_necessity_tests: design should leave reset/wrong-history/source-rich interventions explicit for later runs
design should separate closed-loop performance from self-identification evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: promoted M1362 public base and source-rich config artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source-rich design reveals missing tooling, route to tooling rather than weakening source-rich claim boundaries.
allowed_claims: no source-rich result, private-holdout, high-fidelity, real-vehicle, paper-level, L0/L1/L2/L3, or strong self-identification claim

hypothesis: A promoted-base source-rich public generalization gate can be designed without private holdout, proxy-physics overclaiming, or PPO.
success_criteria: design specifies source-rich public distributions, metrics, and pass/fail criteria
design specifies current-model fault versus proxy/future-only claim boundary
design specifies how L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison is ordered relative to source-rich validation
no training, PPO, evaluation, private holdout, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design uses private holdout for debugging
design claims high-fidelity or paper-level source-rich evidence without a run
training, PPO, evaluation, private holdout, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1372 passes as design only if it defines a promoted-base source-rich public generalization gate while keeping private holdout, PPO, high-fidelity claims, and actor-input changes blocked.
